name: Seacoast United Youth Soccer Camps
description_short: Youth soccer camps run by Seacoast United Soccer Club's coaching staff in several locations in Massachusetts, Maine and New Hampshire. Options include Grassroots (ages 3-6), Summer Skills (6-14), Advanced Training (7-15), Goalkeeper, and Residential (9-18) camps.
refund_policy_summary: No refunds. All registration fees are non-refundable for any reason, including program cancellation, injury, absence or non-participation. Families who withdraw after the season starts still owe all remaining payments.

sources.note: Youth camps overview: camp types and ages, refund policy; P.O. Box, email and phone in the footer

warnings: This is a general overview page for several types of soccer camps. It lists no dates, prices or bookable sessions, and no season year.
Age ranges conflict: Residential Camps are titled '9-18 YEARS' but the text says 'U7 to U18'. Goalkeeper camps say 'all ages' but also 'U9 to U19'.
Camp types differ: Residential Camps are overnight, and the rest seem to be day programs. A single camp_type cannot describe all of them.
The only address is a mailing address (P.O. Box 779, Hampton, NH 03842). Camps run at several locations in MA, ME and NH, so no location was recorded.
The refund policy is strict: no refunds even if the program is cancelled.
unknowns: Season year and session dates (no dates are listed)
Registration URL and when registration opens
Daily hours and whether extended care is offered
Residential camp details: where it is held, overnight lodging, and meals

open_questions: This is a club-wide overview of soccer camps run at many sites in MA, ME and NH, with only a Hampton, NH P.O. box. No Maine site, date or price is posted ('2027 Residential Camps will be available in January'). Drop it, or wait and list specific Maine sites (the Maine regional director is Kevin Mollison) once 2027 camps are posted?
Mixed formats: Residential Camps are overnight (5 days, 4 nights, meals included) with a commuter option; the other camps are day clinics. One camp_type cannot cover both.
Age labels conflict on the camp's own pages: Residential says '9-18 YEARS' and 'U7 to U18'; Goalkeeper says 'all ages' and 'U9 to U19'.
The residential page also lists a non-refundable $100 deposit, on top of the club-wide no-refunds policy.
